cover_dek: A digital money exchange pledged billions to cover losses from a record hack.
big_headline: Binance, a cryptocurrency exchange that trades digital money, allocated $6.34 billion.
big_body: A hack drained around US$6.3 billion from its wallet. Binance pledged to cover all losses, and partners froze $3 billion in affected assets.
pol_body: The Bank of Japan says inflation hit its 2% target after more than 13 years. It kept its policy rate steady at 1.25% and held off hiking interest rates for now.
pol_stat_l2: hit by the Bank of Japan
biz_body: ExxonMobil and Chevron beat profit estimates, which are predicted results. BP is paying off debt, which is borrowed money.
up_headline: Bank of England expected to hike rates
up_body: Analysts predict the Bank of England will vote to raise interest rates from 3.75 per cent to four per cent next week to contain inflation.
